name: Dinner by Heston Blumenthal
address: Mandarin Oriental Hyde Park, 66 Knightsbridge, London, SW1X 7LA
dinnerNote: The Legacy menu, 6 courses (4-course Discovery menu £155); closing for good at the end of January 2027
lunchNote: Lunch set menu · Mon, Thu and Fri

menus.name: Legacy menu
menus.note: Part of A Journey Through History. Lunch or dinner, every day except Tuesday and Wednesday; wine pairings available, price not listed.

menus.note: Part of A Journey Through History. Lunch or dinner, every day except Tuesday and Wednesday.

menus.note: Fixed price per person for the à la carte, offered at dinner Monday to Thursday on the booking page.

menus.name: Lunch set menu

menus.name: Chef's Table menu
menus.note: Chef's Table for two to six guests, lunch or dinner; 8 courses £255.

menus.name: King's Table menu
menus.note: Private dining room for up to 12, lunch or dinner; 5 courses £190.

bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms or by phone. Tables are released 3 months ahead to the day. The reservations line is open 9am to 6pm every day.
cancellation: A card is needed to hold every booking. Cancel in writing at least 72 hours ahead, or a fee of £50 a person may be charged; the same applies to no-shows. The Chef's Table and private dining room have a 14-day policy (£200 a person at the Chef's Table, £2,000 for the private room).
walkIns: Bookings are not essential, but the restaurant recommends booking ahead; if nothing shows online, call.
groups: The Chef's Table seats two to six and the King's Table private dining room up to 12; both can be booked up to 6 months ahead through the events team (+44 20 7201 3844).
dressCode: Smart casual. Jackets and ties are not required.
duration: Tables for two are kept for 2 hours, for three or four for 2½ hours, and for five or six for 3 hours.
